jobs.rowFilter: Rows relevant to the two reporting weeks, including later updates of jobs created before the end boundary. Other rows are omitted; page returnedCount retains the original API page size.

oracle.rowFilter: Rows relevant to the two reporting weeks, including later updates of jobs created before the end boundary. Other rows are omitted; page returnedCount retains the original API page size.

hourly.limitation: Only the latest 24 hours are exposed. A request for 168 hours ending at the week boundary still returned hours:24 and a current until value.

leadersCollection.selection: All jobs last updated on or after the start boundary, including jobs created earlier and jobs now blocked. The list scan began at 2026-01-01 and exhausted the endpoint back to its oldest returned job on 2026-08-23. Each candidate was fetched from /jobs/:id.
leadersCollection.acceptanceTime: Accepted node updatedAt, as exposed by the public record. Current snapshots cannot reconstruct later changes to historical state.
